Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 180 services in tech, data and analytics, non-financial risk and compliance to ING units worldwide. We started in 2015 as ING’s software development centre and have since grown into a global capability hub, continuously expanding our services and expertise. Today, more than 2,300 professionals design and deliver digital products for easier banking everywhere, working across key domains including: Tech Foundation and Channels​, Core Banking and Architecture​, Data and Analytics, Global Products and Technology Services, Payment and Settlement Services, Risk Services​ and Product and Operations. From engineers and data experts to risk specialists, product and operations professionals and beyond, our colleagues enjoy a flexible way of working and a collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things, one innovative solution at a time.
Discover ING Hubs RomaniaING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as INGs software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from Bucharest.Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionAs a Data Management Expert IV, you play a key role in ensuring that data is trusted, discoverable, governed and reusable across the organization. You bridge business, data and technology, transforming complex business needs into scalable data solutions that create tangible value. Furthermore, you help shape the tribes data strategy.Your day to dayYou represent the business and data consumers in a multidisciplinary product team. Your responsibilities include:Discovering consumer needs and translating them into requirements, models and acceptance criteria.Aligning the scope and meaning of data from source systems to consumers.Performing data profiling, mapping and SQL-based analysis.Developing conceptual, logical and dimensional data models.Working with engineers and architects to deliver scalable solutions.Defining data definitions, lineage, quality rules, privacy classifications and metadata.Embedding data-governance, risk, security and data-protection requirements.Testing data products and safeguarding their quality, consistency and usability.Coordinating the sustainable resolution of data-quality issues and incidents.Facilitating workshops and aligning business, data and technology stakeholders.Promoting Data as a Product and self-service principles.Coaching colleagues and contributing to the DME community.At DME IV level, you create impact across the tribe. You help develop its data strategy, improve data-governance awareness, coordinate the embedding of risk requirements and promote product thinking.What youll bring to the teamExtensive experience in data management, data governance, data modelling, business analysis.Experience translating complex business needs into sustainable data solutions.Knowledge of data architecture, data products, metadata, lineage, data quality and data protection.Experience with SQL, data analysis and functional or technical testing.Strong analytical, stakeholder-management and communication skills.The ability to influence, coach and create alignment across teams.Experience in an Agile, multidisciplinary and international environment.If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
